owner_decisions: Lab/environment owner must supply attributable current entitlement, policy, capacity, permissions, quota and budget evidence; subscription Enabled alone is insufficient.
Evidence owner must recover an authentic complete historical answer and its citation mapping, or explicitly approve a narrower historical claim. Do not reconstruct clipped screenshots.
Connector owner must provide a supported retained raw failure payload if available, or explicitly keep downstream error-body fidelity unverified. Do not resend mail or manufacture another failure.

lab_02.limit: This is not a fresh licensing-index read or a substitute for native connected-answer proof.

lab_02.blocked: Actual navigation from the answer citation to the external PDF, plus a whole-answer audit of the original licensing-options question.
lab_02.non_substitution: The separately observed native publisher PDF viewer does not establish a clickthrough from this connected answer.

owner_decisions: Lab owner must authorize any future resource restoration and retain failed attempts; this pass does not authorize provisioning.
Evidence owner must capture actual citation activation into the external PDF, not merely a matching target string or an independently opened viewer.
Telemetry/privacy owner must define the acceptable boundary for unavoidable platform identifier keys and provide attributable approval or remediation; all-identifiers-absent cannot be inferred.
Release and telemetry owners must arrange a separately approved published-channel test if the roadmap criterion remains in scope.
